				}
			}

		loginLoad: {
			start: function (form, timeout) {
				if (!timeout) {
				    timeout = 5000;
				}

				var loginButton = $(form).find(".button").addClass("waiting");
				setTimeout(function () {
				    loginButton.removeClass("waiting");
				}, timeout);

				buttonInput.prop("disabled", true);
				$button.addClass("waiting");

				setTimeout(function () {
					$button.removeClass("waiting");
					buttonInput.prop("disabled", false);
				}, 5000);
			}
		},
		defaultOption: null
	};
	loadingOptions.defaultOption = loadingOptions.spinner.start;

	$(window).on("load", function () {
		loadingOptions.spinner.init();
	});

        <div class="accordion-inner text-links" role="region" id="accordian-inner-7" aria-labelledby="accordian-header-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">
            <p>While Progressive boasts some of the broadest acceptability in the business, there are some types of vessels that can't be added to a new or existing Progressive policy:</p><ul class="bullets"><li>Boats 0-10 years old and worth more than $500,000</li><li>Boats 11-20 years old and worth more than $350,000</li><li>Boats more than 20 years old and worth more than $75,000</li><li>Boats used as a primary residence (live-aboards)</li><li>All houseboats</li><li>Homemade boats without a hull identification number</li><li>Boats with more than two owners</li><li>Boats with steel or wood hulls</li><li>All amphibious land boats, hovercraft, or airboats</li><li>PWCs worth more than $27,000</li><li>Boats that don't meet published U.S. Coast Guard standards</li></ul><p>We also can't insure boats over 50 feet in length. In some hurricane-prone states, the limits can be 35 feet and $175,000 in value.</p>
        </div>
    </li>
        </ul>
        
    </div>

				}, 5000);
			}
		},

Boat insurance safeguards your watercraft against damage and theft, in or out of the water. Plus, boat liability coverage protects you if you cause damages or injuries while boating. Whether you have a pontoon, power boat, or personal watercraft, we can help you boat worry-free with a quick, customized boat insurance quote. Check out all of the types of watercraft we cover . Stay on course for savings with boat insurance discounts Progressive may automatically apply these discounts and more to your policy. Featured Multi-policy Save on your boat insurance by bundling it with another Progressive policy, such as home, auto, motorcycle, or RV. Boat safety course Complete a boater safety course approved by your state and earn a discount on your policy. Pay in full An easy way to save — earn a discount for paying your policy up front and in full. See all boat insurance discounts WHY CHOOSE US? Affordable coverage A dependable boat insurance policy shouldn't drown your wallet. Learn the claims process #1 boat insurer Join your fellow boaters in choosing the top boat insurer. §§ Explore our coverages to get started. Explore boat coverages Types of boats we insure As long as your watercraft is valued at no more than $500,000 and is up to 50 feet long, we'll most likely insure it. †† Don't see your watercraft listed here? Call 1-855-347-3939 and we'll do what we can to get you covered. Personal watercraft (PWC) These include Jet-Skis, Sea-Doos, WaveRunners, and similar watercraft meant for one to three people. Sailboats Boats that use at least one sail for power, although they may also have a motor. Pontoon boats Boats built on hollow metal cylinders for cruising on lakes and rivers. Powerboats The most popular type of boat. Used for fishing, cruising, watersports, and more. Bass and fishing boats Boats built specifically for fishing, with features like trolling motors, power poles, etc. See more types See less types Boat insurance coverage options that protect you and your boat Progressive offers more than just standard boat coverages, so you can hit the water knowing you're prepared for any mishap. On-water boat towing Covers boat towing assistance, fuel delivery, and more View details Progressive's optional Sign & Glide ® coverage † pays for boat towing assistance, fuel delivery, ** soft ungroundings, and jump starts. Download our Sign & Glide app on your smart phone and never worry about an on-water breakdown. Comprehensive and collision Covers damage to your boat from incidents in and out of your control View details Boat comprehensive and collision are coverages that can safeguard your boat against damage and loss. Comprehensive covers events beyond your control, such as theft, vandalism and weather-related issues. Collision protects your watercraft if it collides with an object or another boat. Propulsion Plus® Covers your watercraft's upper and/or lower units in case of mechanical breakdown View details Add Propulsion Plus and we may repair or replace the lower unit of an outboard motor, or upper and lower units of an inboard/outboard motor, if you have a mechanical breakdown. Wreckage removal and fuel spill Covers sunken boats and fuel leaks View details These are automatically included in every Progressive boat insurance policy. If your boat sinks or you're responsible for a fuel spill, we can cover the cost up to your policy's limits. We only remove your sunken boat if it's legally required. See all boat coverages How much is boat insurance? You can typically get a Progressive boat insurance policy for as low as $100 per year. * However, your rate is based on numerous factors, including location, boat type, boating history, and prior claims. Learn more about what impacts the cost of boat insurance . How much is boat insurance in your state? Select your state to find out the average cost of boat insurance. Alabama Alaska Arizona Arkansas California Colorado Connecticut Delaware Florida Georgia Hawaii Idaho Illinois Indiana Iowa Kansas Kentucky Louisiana Maine Maryland Massachusetts Michigan Minnesota Mississippi Missouri Montana Nebraska Nevada New Hampshire New Jersey New Mexico New York North Carolina North Dakota Ohio Oklahoma Oregon Pennsylvania Rhode Island South Carolina South Dakota Tennessee Texas Utah Vermont Virginia Washington West Virginia Wisconsin Wyoming Is boat insurance required? Although boat insurance is mandated in only a few states, you're typically required by your lender to carry comprehensive and collision coverage if you finance your boat. Additionally, if you dock your boat, your marina may require you to show proof of liability coverage. Find out the boat insurance requirements in your state . Does boat insurance cover theft? Comprehensive coverage can pay to replace a stolen watercraft , minus your policy's deductible. Does homeowners insurance cover boats? A homeowners policy typically won't cover damage to your boat. Depending on the situation and your policy, personal liability coverage under your homeowners insurance may cover injuries that occur on your watercraft if you're liable. Are carry-on items covered by boat insurance? If personal belongings that you bring on board are lost or stolen, Progressive offers coverage of up to $10,000 for fishing equipment and up to $5,000 for other items, such as laptops, smart phones, and scuba gear. Does boat insurance cover the boat trailer? Damage to your boat trailer is typically covered if you add your trailer to your boat insurance policy. You're protected against damage to your boat trailer even if your boat isn't on the trailer at the time of the incident. Learn more about boat trailer insurance . Does Progressive require a marine survey? We don't require a marine survey to purchase a boat insurance policy. What types of boats and PWCs does Progressive not insure? While Progressive boasts some of the broadest acceptability in the business, there are some types of vessels that can't be added to a new or existing Progressive policy: Boats 0-10 years old and worth more than $500,000 Boats 11-20 years old and worth more than $350,000 Boats more than 20 years old and worth more than $75,000 Boats used as a primary residence (live-aboards) All houseboats Homemade boats without a hull identification number Boats with more than two owners Boats with steel or wood hulls All amphibious land boats, hovercraft, or airboats PWCs worth more than $27,000 Boats that don't meet published U.S. Coast Guard standards We also can't insure boats over 50 feet in length. In some hurricane-prone states, the limits can be 35 feet and $175,000 in value. acceptedAnswer.text: You can typically get a Progressive boat insurance policy for as low as $100 per year.* However, your rate is based on numerous factors, including location, boat type, boating history, and prior claims. Learn more about what impacts the cost of boat insurance.

Although boat insurance is mandated in only a few states, you're typically required by your lender to carry comprehensive and collision coverage if you finance your boat. Additionally, if you dock your boat, your marina may require you to show proof of liability coverage. Find out the boat insurance requirements in your state.
Comprehensive coverage can pay to replace a stolen watercraft, minus your policy's deductible.

A homeowners policy typically won't cover damage to your boat. Depending on the situation and your policy, personal liability coverage under your homeowners insurance may cover injuries that occur on your watercraft if you're liable.

mainEntity.name: Are carry-on items covered by boat insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: If personal belongings that you bring on board are lost or stolen, Progressive offers coverage of up to $10,000 for fishing equipment and up to $5,000 for other items, such as laptops, smart phones, and scuba gear.

mainEntity.name: Does boat insurance cover the boat trailer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Damage to your boat trailer is typically covered if you add your trailer to your boat insurance policy. You're protected against damage to your boat trailer even if your boat isn't on the trailer at the time of the incident. Learn more about boat trailer insurance.

mainEntity.name: Does Progressive require a marine survey?

acceptedAnswer.text: We don't require a marine survey to purchase a boat insurance policy.

mainEntity.name: What types of boats and PWCs does Progressive not insure?

acceptedAnswer.text:
While Progressive boasts some of the broadest acceptability in the business, there are some types of vessels that can't be added to a new or existing Progressive policy:

  • Boats 0-10 years old and worth more than $500,000
  • Boats 11-20 years old and worth more than $350,000
  • Boats more than 20 years old and worth more than $75,000
  • Boats used as a primary residence (live-aboards)
  • All houseboats
  • Homemade boats without a hull identification number
  • Boats with more than two owners
  • Boats with steel or wood hulls
  • All amphibious land boats, hovercraft, or airboats
  • PWCs worth more than $27,000
  • Boats that don't meet published U.S. Coast Guard standards

We also can't insure boats over 50 feet in length. In some hurricane-prone states, the limits can be 35 feet and $175,000 in value.

Although boat insurance is mandated in only a few states, you're typically required by your lender to carry comprehensive and collision coverage if you finance your boat. Additionally, if you dock your boat, your marina may require you to show proof of liability coverage. Find out the boat insurance requirements in your state.

	<h1>Why Insurance Prices May Vary</h1>
<p>Progressive offers choices so you can reach us whenever, wherever, and however it’s most convenient.  You can choose how you want to buy your car or other vehicle insurance:  directly from a Progressive company (online, by phone, or on a mobile device), or through an independent agent or broker.</p>
<p>Because there are differences in expenses or other business aspects among these sales channels, prices may vary based on how you buy. For example, if you buy through an agent or broker, your car insurance price includes the commission paid to the agent or broker selling the policy. If you buy directly from a Progressive company, your <a href="https://www.progressive.com/auto/">car insurance</a> price reflects the cost of staffing and maintaining the sales centers, and a larger portion of our marketing costs.</p>
<p>But no matter how you buy your Progressive policy, you’ll still receive the benefits and services that the Progressive companies offer to their customers, including 24/7 customer, claims and online service.</p>

You can choose how you want to buy your car or other vehicle insurance: directly from a Progressive company (online, by phone, or on a mobile device), or through an independent agent or broker. Because there are differences in expenses or other business aspects among these sales channels, prices may vary based on how you buy. For example, if you buy through an agent or broker, your car insurance price includes the commission paid to the agent or broker selling the policy. If you buy directly from a Progressive company, your car insurance price reflects the cost of staffing and maintaining the sales centers, and a larger portion of our marketing costs. But no matter how you buy your Progressive policy, you’ll still receive the benefits and services that the Progressive companies offer to their customers, including 24/7 customer, claims and online service. 	var loadingOptions = {
		lockForm: function (form) {
			$(form).find(":input").attr('disabled', '');
			$(form).find(":input").blur();
		},
		unlockForm: function (form) {
			$(form).find(":input").removeAttr('disabled');
		},
		spinner: {
			init: function () {
				$("form").find(".button").append("<div class='spinner'><p>Loading</p><ul><li></li><li></li><li></li></ul></div>");
			},
			start: function (form) {
				$button = $(form).find(".button").addClass("waiting");

				return function () {
					setTimeout(function () {
						$button.removeClass("waiting");
					}, 5000);
				}
			}
        },
		loginLoad: {
			start: function (form, timeout) {
				if (!timeout) {
				    timeout = 5000;
				}

				var loginButton = $(form).find(".button").addClass("waiting");
				setTimeout(function () {
				    loginButton.removeClass("waiting");
				}, timeout);

				return function () {
				    loginButton.removeClass("waiting");
				}
			}
		},
		disable: {
			start: function (form) {
				var $button = $(form).find(".button");
				var buttonInput = $button.find("input[type=button],input[type=submit],button");
				buttonInput.prop("disabled", true);
				$button.addClass("waiting");

				setTimeout(function () {
					$button.removeClass("waiting");
					buttonInput.prop("disabled", false);
				}, 5000);
			}
		},
		defaultOption: null
	};
	loadingOptions.defaultOption = loadingOptions.spinner.start;

	$(window).on("load", function () {
		loadingOptions.spinner.init();
	});

	/* Loading options / Spinner
	/* - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - */

	var loadingOptions = {
		lockForm: function (form) {
			$(form).find(":input").attr('disabled', '');
			$(form).find(":input").blur();
		},
		unlockForm: function (form) {
			$(form).find(":input").removeAttr('disabled');
		},
		spinner: {
			init: function () {
				$("form").find(".button").append("<div class='spinner'><p>Loading</p><ul><li></li><li></li><li></li></ul></div>");
			},
			start: function (form) {
				$button = $(form).find(".button").addClass("waiting");

				return function () {
					setTimeout(function () {
						$button.removeClass("waiting");
					}, 5000);
				}
			}
        },
		loginLoad: {
			start: function (form, timeout) {
				if (!timeout) {
				    timeout = 5000;
				}

				var loginButton = $(form).find(".button").addClass("waiting");
				setTimeout(function () {
				    loginButton.removeClass("waiting");
				}, timeout);

				return function () {
				    loginButton.removeClass("waiting");
				}
			}
		},
		disable: {
			start: function (form) {
				var $button = $(form).find(".button");
				var buttonInput = $button.find("input[type=button],input[type=submit],button");
				buttonInput.prop("disabled", true);
				$button.addClass("waiting");

				setTimeout(function () {
					$button.removeClass("waiting");
					buttonInput.prop("disabled", false);
				}, 5000);
			}
		},
		defaultOption: null
	};
	loadingOptions.defaultOption = loadingOptions.spinner.start;

	$(window).on("load", function () {
		loadingOptions.spinner.init();
	});
</script>

We’ve made getting the car insurance rate you want a whole lot easier. Quote car insurance now and use our Name Your Price tool to tell us how much you’d like to pay. Then, we show the best coverage options to meet your budget. Just one of many ways you can save with Progressive. How the Name Your Price tool works: 01 Get a quote We need some basic info to determine your lowest and highest possible rates from us. 02 Try it Use the Name Your Price tool and tell us how much you want to pay. 03 Choose a policy We show you coverage options that fit your desired price. Find the right balance between your budget and coverage Remember, our lowest price may not include all the protection you want, but you can adjust coverages until they meet your needs before buying your policy. Check out even more ways to save with Progressive As a leading auto insurer, we have many tools and discounts to help you get the best rate — 99% of our auto customers earn at least one discount! Savings! Bundle and save! New customers who bundle their home and auto save $1,086 on average. ** You can save when you combine other policies too, including renters, boat, motorcycle, and more. Save with Snapshot®† Snapshot personalizes your rate based on your actual driving habits. The safer you drive, the more you can save. Student discounts Students with a B average or better can earn our good student discount for auto insurance! †† See all car insurance discounts Common questions about the Name Your Price tool Is the Name Your Price tool a price matching tool? No, the Name Your Price tool helps you build a policy that fits your budget and offers the coverage you need. We can't match prices against quotes you receive from other insurance companies. Can the Name Your Price tool lower my rate? The Name Your Price tool helps you find a policy that fits your budget based on your coverage needs. Cheapest doesn't always mean the best protection. For example, if you're concerned about affording repair bills after an accident, it may make sense to pay more and add comprehensive and collision coverages to your policy. If you're looking for the lowest possible rate, there are ways to save a bit more and get cheaper car insurance . How do I figure out the right coverage for me? Use our car insurance calculator to estimate how much coverage you need based on your assets, what you use your vehicle for and how much it's worth, and other info. Better insurance. Big savings.
